visual_review: Side-view bed with a tall headboard, a mattress band on legs, the sleeper's head resting on the mattress and a rounded blanket hump, as in the reference. The current drawing floated the head in mid-air above an open r-shaped frame, with no mattress band or blanket, so it read as a glyph rather than a bed.
omissions: The footboard doubles as the blanket's right side (a separate foot post would need 8 more units of width).
